#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf using the pdf skill tooling."""
import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT_PDF = "report_with_cover.pdf"
COVER_PDF = "cover_page.pdf"

# 1) Verify the input file exists
if not Path(INPUT_PDF).exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"{INPUT_PDF} not found in workspace")

reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
print(f"Original pages: {len(reader.pages)}")

# 2) Create the cover page with title and current date
c = canvas.Canvas(COVER_PDF, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

title = "Annual Financial Report"
today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
title_width = c.stringWidth(title, "Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawString((width - title_width) / 2, height - 300, title)

c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
date_text = today
date_width = c.stringWidth(date_text, "Helvetica", 16)
c.drawString((width - date_width) / 2, height - 350, date_text)

c.save()
print(f"Cover page created: {COVER_PDF} (title={title!r}, date={today!r})")

# 3) Merge cover page + original pages
writer = PdfWriter()
cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER_PDF)
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUTPUT_PDF, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)
print(f"Output written: {OUTPUT_PDF} with {len(writer.pages)} pages")

# 4) Validate the cover page text
check = PdfReader(OUTPUT_PDF)
text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
print("Cover page extracted text:", repr(text))
assert "Annual Financial Report" in text, "Title missing on cover page"
assert today.split()[-1] in text, "Date year missing on cover page"
print("Validation passed: title and date present on page 1")

import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader

path = "report.pdf"

    print(f"ERROR: {path} not found in {os.getcwd()}")
    print("Files in cwd:")
    for f in sorted(os.listdir(".")):

    sys.exit(1)

    print(f"Title: {meta.title}")
    print(f"Author: {meta.author}")
print("First page text preview:")

print(first_text[:500] if first_text else "(no extractable text)")

"""Probe which PDF-generation libraries are available."""
import importlib

mods = [
    "reportlab",
    "fpdf",
    "pypdf",
    "PyPDF2",
    "pdfplumber",
    "pdfkit",
    "weasyprint",
    "borb",
    "fitz",
    "pikepdf",
]

        print(f"OK   {m} {getattr(mod, '__version__', '?')}")

# Check for command-line tools
import shutil
for tool in ["pdftotext", "qpdf", "pdftk", "gs", "libreoffice", "soffice"]:
    print(f"CLI  {tool}: {shutil.which(tool)}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf using only pypdf.

Constructs the cover page content stream manually (no reportlab dependency).
"""
import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from pypdf.generic import (
    DecodedStreamObject,
    DictionaryObject,
    NameObject,
)

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT_PDF = "report_with_cover.pdf"

PAGE_W = 612  # letter width
PAGE_H = 792  # letter height

# Helvetica width tables (units per 1000 em) for accurate centering.
HELV_BOLD = {
    " ": 278,
    "A": 722, "B": 722, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611, "G": 778,
    "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 556, "K": 722, "L": 611, "M": 833, "N": 722,
    "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722,
    "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "a": 556, "b": 611, "c": 556, "d": 611, "e": 556, "f": 333, "g": 611,
    "h": 611, "i": 278, "j": 278, "k": 556, "l": 278, "m": 889, "n": 611,
    "o": 611, "p": 611, "q": 611, "r": 389, "s": 556, "t": 333, "u": 611,
    "v": 556, "w": 778, "x": 556, "y": 556, "z": 500,
    "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556,
    ",": 278, ".": 278,
}
HELV = {
    " ": 278,
    "A": 667, "B": 667, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611, "G": 778,
    "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 500, "K": 667, "L": 556, "M": 833, "N": 722,
    "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722,
    "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "a": 556, "b": 556, "c": 500, "d": 556, "e": 556, "f": 278, "g": 556,
    "h": 556, "i": 222, "j": 222, "k": 500, "l": 222, "m": 833, "n": 556,
    "o": 556, "p": 556, "q": 556, "r": 333, "s": 500, "t": 278, "u": 556,
    "v": 500, "w": 722, "x": 500, "y": 500, "z": 500,
    "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556,
    ",": 278, ".": 278,
}


def text_width(text, font_size, widths):
    units = sum(widths.get(ch, 500) for ch in text)
    return units / 1000.0 * font_size


def escape_pdf_string(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_cover_content(title, date_text):
    title_font_size = 28
    date_font_size = 16
    title_width = text_width(title, title_font_size, HELV_BOLD)
    date_width = text_width(date_text, date_font_size, HELV)
    title_x = (PAGE_W - title_width) / 2.0
    date_x = (PAGE_W - date_width) / 2.0
    title_y = PAGE_H - 300  # baseline, matching the original plan
    date_y = PAGE_H - 350

    lines = [
        "BT",
        f"/F1 {title_font_size} Tf",
        "0 0 0 rg",
        f"{title_x:.2f} {title_y:.2f} Td",
        f"({escape_pdf_string(title)}) Tj",
        "ET",
        "BT",
        f"/F2 {date_font_size} Tf",
        "0 0 0 rg",
        f"{date_x:.2f} {date_y:.2f} Td",
        f"({escape_pdf_string(date_text)}) Tj",
        "ET",
    ]
    return ("\n".join(lines) + "\n").encode("latin-1")


def main():
    if not Path(INPUT_PDF).exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{INPUT_PDF} not found in workspace")

    reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    print(f"Original pages: {len(reader.pages)}")

    today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    title = "Annual Financial Report"

    writer = PdfWriter()

    # --- Build the cover page ---
    cover = writer.add_blank_page(width=PAGE_W, height=PAGE_H)

    content = DecodedStreamObject()
    content.set_data(build_cover_content(title, today))

    font_bold = DictionaryObject({
        NameObject("/Type"): NameObject("/Font"),
        NameObject("/Subtype"): NameObject("/Type1"),
        NameObject("/BaseFont"): NameObject("/Helvetica-Bold"),
    })
    font_regular = DictionaryObject({
        NameObject("/Type"): NameObject("/Font"),
        NameObject("/Subtype"): NameObject("/Type1"),
        NameObject("/BaseFont"): NameObject("/Helvetica"),
    })
    resources = DictionaryObject({
        NameObject("/Font"): DictionaryObject({
            NameObject("/F1"): font_bold,
            NameObject("/F2"): font_regular,
        })
    })

    cover[NameObject("/Contents")] = content
    cover[NameObject("/Resources")] = resources

    # --- Append the original report pages ---
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(OUTPUT_PDF, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    total = len(writer.pages)
    print(f"Output written: {OUTPUT_PDF} with {total} pages")

    # --- Validate ---
    check = PdfReader(OUTPUT_PDF)
    text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    print("Cover page extracted text:", repr(text))
    assert "Annual Financial Report" in text, "Title missing on cover page"
    assert today.split()[-1] in text, "Date year missing on cover page"
    print("Validation passed: title and date present on page 1")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
